Hymn 319: Ye Elders of Israel
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Thomas H. Bayly
Lyricist/Text Author: Cyrus H. Wheelock
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 319 titled "Ye Elders of Israel" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Thomas H. Bayly and the lyrics were written by Cyrus H. Wheelock.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
